reserve.assembly:
.macro field name, base, offset, value, bytes, kind, continuation
    .global \name
\name:
    save
    addi t0, \base, \offset
    sw t0, 64(sp)
    sw \value, 68(sp)
    li t0, \bytes
    sw t0, 72(sp)
    lw a0, 64(sp)
    lw a1, 68(sp)
    lw a2, 72(sp)
    call npu_emulation_tx_reserve
    beqz a0, .Lfailed\kind
    lw t0, 64(sp)
    lw t1, 68(sp)
    fence iorw, iorw
    .if \bytes == 2
    sh t1, 0(t0)
    .else
    sw t1, 0(t0)
    .endif
    fence iorw, iorw
    lw a0, 64(sp)
    lw a1, 72(sp)
    call npu_emulation_tx_publish
    beqz a0, .Lfailed\kind
    restore
    .ifc \name,npu_emulation_tx_reg0
    and a5, a5, a4
    .endif
    j \continuation
    .endm

state.requirements: Reserve before original stores, publish only after readback under pinned ownership, retain all partial progress and outer lease after failure; no reset or retirement. Register preimages are captured values, not assumed zero. Only modeled execution is tested; physical ownership/coherency/drains remain open.

reserve_before_store.instructions: Does reserve.assembly call reserve.native/core successfully before its original field store? Do not infer physical exclusivity from software ownership.

readback_before_publish.instructions: Does publish.native read the allowed target and require pinned ownership, while publish.core checks the expected address/width/value before advancing published?

retained_failure.instructions: According to retained.callback and retained.native_fault/core_fault, what happens to partial progress on failure?

criteria.retain_and_deny: Latch faults, keep partial TX counters/claims and deny callback success.
criteria.rollback: Restore original values and reset TX counters.
criteria.not_established: The supplied source does not establish the policy.

preimage_policy.instructions: In retained.callback, what precondition is used for native register preimages?

criteria.captured: Capture the four existing native register values into the pinned plan.
criteria.forced_zero: Require those four registers to start at zero.
criteria.unvalidated: Do not capture or validate preimages.

retirement_api.instructions: Does retained.api expose a function to reset/reinitialize a used owner or retire/reclaim its committed resources? Initial begin on fresh zero storage is not such a reset API.

physical_claim.instructions: Do requirements claim modeled readback or software pinned ownership establishes physical DMA exclusion, coherency or drain proof?
